description: A Minecraft Fabric mod that ables people to open Shulker Box within inventories by right clicking them.

mods.name: Right-Shulker-Box
mods.description: Right-click any shulker box sitting in any inventory to open its contents in place, without taking it out or placing it down. All logic is server-authoritative; loads on both client and dedicated server so it also works in singleplayer.
